one_liner: Third-party API (TranscriptAPI.com) that fetches YouTube video transcripts, metadata, search, and channel/playlist data.

auth.evidence_quote: The API uses Bearer token authentication. Include your API key in the Authorization header of every request
auth.notes: Primary auth is an API key sent as a Bearer token; docs also mention OAuth support for platforms like Claude/ChatGPT (via MCP).

access.notes: Credit-based self-serve model; users get free starting credits (100 per search results) and two endpoints are free even without credits. No sales approval required.

api.evidence_quote: The API documentation lists 16 distinct endpoints across several categories: transcript extraction, video metadata, search functionality, and channel/playlist operations.
api.notes: Vendor-published MCP docs page exists at transcriptapi.com/docs/mcp/, treated as official since it's the same vendor, not a third-party aggregator.

verdict.rationale: Self-serve API key signup with free credits, documented REST API and an official MCP integration page.
